menu.title: What do you want to add?
menu.description: STT wrapper: listens to the audio and recognizes who is speaking (fires the speaker_recognition_detected event). Conversation wrapper: passes the recognized speaker on as the user of the request. Add the STT wrapper first.

menu_options.add_stt: STT wrapper (recognizes the speaker from audio)
menu_options.add_conversation: Conversation agent wrapper (passes the speaker on)

main.title: Speaker Recognition service
main.description: Backend service and voice samples. Samples must be WAV, 16 kHz mono, in the Home Assistant media folder.

data_description.backend_url: Address of the speaker recognition service, e.g. http://192.168.1.65:8099
data_description.voice_samples: Per user one or more audio files; multiple files are combined into one voice profile

add_stt.title: Add STT wrapper
add_stt.description: Wraps an existing speech-to-text entity and recognizes the speaker from the audio. Select it as speech-to-text in your Assist pipeline.

add_conversation.title: Add conversation agent wrapper
add_conversation.description: Wraps an existing conversation agent and sets the recognized speaker as the user of the request. Requires the STT wrapper in the same pipeline.

data_description.min_confidence: Minimum recognition confidence (0.0-1.0) before the speaker is passed on

error.not_stt_entity: The selected entity is not a speech-to-text entity
error.not_conversation_entity: The selected entity is not a conversation agent
